_comment: Source of truth for the cli_commands[] portion of .vrooli/endpoints.json. Hand-maintained because the CLI is a separate Go module from the API; cross-module codegen would force one to import the other. Each entry mirrors a real subcommand registered in cli/domains/<dom>/register.go (or cli-core's StandardScenarioApp built-ins). Codegen verifies every cli_mapping.command in endpoints[] has a matching name here. Product subcommands (graph extract, rewrite plan, rewrite apply) land here as the corresponding domains ship.

cli_commands.name: status
cli_commands.description: Check API and dependency health (auto-provided by cli-core's StandardScenarioApp)

cli_commands.name: graph extract
cli_commands.description: Extract a deterministic TypeScript graph for the project at <path>.

cli_commands.name: graph list-fixtures
cli_commands.description: List the golden determinism fixtures shipped with the scenario.

cli_commands.name: graph validate-fixture
cli_commands.description: Re-extract a fixture and byte-compare against its expected-graph.json.

cli_commands.name: rewrite apply
cli_commands.description: Apply the rewrite plan identified by <plan_id>.
